8 vs 14: Nepal's 2025 official profile lists 14 peaks above 8,000 m by adding six subsidiary summits to the eight main eight-thousanders. UIAA/international recognition remains eight. The atlas presents both classes without adjudicating the dispute.

Geometry: peaks are point symbols only. No peak polygon, buffer or viewshed is drawn. Elevations vary by source; figures are compiled from Wikidata, Wikipedia and the Himalayan Database.

Protected areas: under D10 (DNPWC deferral) no protected-area or buffer-zone polygon is shown. Attributes appear in the reference tables. Boundaries are indicative, not legal.

Accuracy: open-data reference edition. Not survey-grade, not a legal boundary determination. Published areas are not measurements of project geometry.
